objective: Freeze a computationally economical but coverage-qualified scene-level OTS development pool that preserves independent outdoor scenes for training, model-development validation, measurement definition, measurement validation, and preregistered expansion.

scene_stratified_partition.core_assumption: The authorized 8,006-scene OTS pool contains complete clear, depth, and haze-parameter assets and can be partitioned by frozen scene-level content and depth features into computationally bounded, mutually exclusive roles without material coverage loss.
scene_stratified_partition.close_condition: Close if required fields are missing, exact role counts or scene-level disjointness fail, or the frozen deterministic stratifier exceeds any role-specific coverage margin.

outdoor_measurement_definition.core_assumption: A disjoint OTS measurement-definition pool with paired depth and controlled haze variants can support a separately frozen local outdoor degradation measurement.
outdoor_measurement_definition.close_condition: Close if a separately specified outdoor measurement lacks construct validity, reliability, coverage, or precision.
